---
name: Library suggestion
about: Propose a resource for the /resources page
title: 'Library: '
labels: library
---

The Library is deliberately small. An entry earns its place by being genuinely among the best
material in the world, and by filling a slot nothing on the page already fills.

**The resource**: name and URL.

**The slot it fills**: what a learner gets here that no current entry provides.

**Your experience with it**: the honest note. How it teaches, where it is weak, who it fits.
The strongest case comes from someone who actually finished it.

**Free or paid**: if the "free" is complicated (personal use only, login needed, archived
version), say so.
